node-1.label: Excessive sweating of the buttocks, most severe at the intergluteal cleft and sacrum

node-2.label: 31-year-old male nursing student with a history of axillary hyperhidrosis; axillary condition was previously treated successfully with 20% aluminum chloride, but aluminum chloride treatment for the intergluteal cleft and sacrum was unsuccessful

node-3.label: Due to severity of sweating, he used absorbent pads yet continued to soak through his pants and was unable to attend work

node-4.label: Physical examination with Minor starch-iodine test identified significant sweating areas in the sacral region (10 × 3 cm) and intergluteal cleft (6 × 8 cm)
